<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadowCard" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="1" stdDeviation="0.8" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.12"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="shadowSoft" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.10"/>
    </filter>
    <linearGradient id="premiumGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F6C780"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#E4A53F"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="chartGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0A66C2" stop-opacity="0.26"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0A66C2" stop-opacity="0.03"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F2EF"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="44" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="18" y="28" font-family="SF Pro Text, Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#1D2226">9:41</text>
    <g fill="#1D2226">
      <rect x="328" y="18" width="3" height="8" rx="1"/>

      <circle cx="356" cy="18" r="2.2" fill="#1D2226"/>

      <line x1="362" y1="15" x2="366" y2="11" stroke="#1D2226" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="362" y1="21" x2="366" y2="25" stroke="#1D2226" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <g>

      <text x="20" y="12" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#1D2226">premium</text>

  </g>

  <g filter="url(#shadowSoft)">
    <rect x="14" y="150" width="362" height="314" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E9E5DF"/>

    <text x="322" y="703" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#0A66C2">Follow</text>

    <!-- divider at card bottom -->
    <line x1="30" y1="724" x2="360" y2="724" stroke="#E0DFDC" stroke-width="1"/>

    <rect x="14" y="754" width="362" height="54" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E0DFDC"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <text x="30" y="780" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#1D2226">People also viewed your Skills section</text>
    <text x="30" y="798" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#585C60">Updated today • 1,482 impressions</text>
    <text x="316" y="790" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#0A66C2">Open</text>
